sentences.en: People used to think the sun revolved around the earth.
sentences.zh: 人们曾经认为太阳围绕地球旋转。

sentences.en: All objects in the Galaxy revolve around the Galaxy's center.
sentences.zh: 银河系中的所有物体都围绕银河系中心旋转。

sentences.en: Dan really believes that the whole world revolves around him.
sentences.zh: 丹真的以为全世界都在围着他自己转。

senses.zh: 使…旋转；使…循环；反复考虑
旋转；循环出现；反复考虑

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（一再）+volve（滚，卷）→不断滚动→旋转
